Changed answer from 'No' to 'Yes' since the paper uses Recall@k and IoU metrics to evaluate generated pseudo queries. Normalized metrics to base forms (Recall, IoU).
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The paper uses traditional evaluation metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on unsupervised video corpus moment retrieval using pseudo query generation. While it generates text (pseudo queries), the main NLG tasks are used as components rather than being the primary evaluation focus. The paper uses Recall@k and IoU metrics for evaluation, but these are applied to the retrieval task rather than directly evaluating the quality of the generated queries themselves.
